summary: As Iowa State Auditor in December 2019, Rob Sand enforced the state's 2016 anti-boycott law and called Israel 'a great ally to us,' urging compliance with disclosure requirements. In October 2023 he posted agreement with Iowa Democrats condemning the Hamas attacks on Israel. The record shows a public official enforcing a law that penalizes boycotts of Israel and explicitly characterizing Israel as an ally, alongside a brief expression of sympathy for Israeli victims.
